official_source_paths.evidence: The official UK PRTR download publication was published 30 June 2026 and updated 24 July 2026; the update explicitly added CSV versions of the annual files.

The official download hub exposes a 1.33 MB 2019 UK PRTR CSV and a View online route. The exact asset URL was resolved, but this environment returned cache/download failure before row content could be read.
The official download hub exposes a 5.36 MB 2024 UK PRTR CSV and a View online route. The exact asset URL was resolved; direct CSV content fetch is unsupported/cache-missed in the current web client.

The UK PRTR guidance confirms that facilities report quantities released to environmental media and documents calculation/measurement/estimation method codes; this establishes lineage and semantics but does not replace raw facility-row readback.

candidate_recheck.reason: A direct official CSV distribution path is now confirmed, but no Part83 facility row was actually read from the CSV in this environment. Numeric values therefore remain secondary reproductions with official facility/company crosschecks and are not promoted to confidence 99 or project-measured state.

ardley_2019_nox.reason: The official 2019 UK PRTR CSV distribution is now located, but the Ardley row itself was not read. The official Cherwell UK-PRTR-attributed value remains candidate-only until raw row readback.

retrieval_evidence.csv_2019_failure: GOV.UK CSV preview/assets returned cache miss and direct container download failed; no row content was fabricated.
retrieval_evidence.csv_2024_failure: Direct asset fetch returned unsupported text/csv in web client and preview cache miss; no row content was fabricated.

quality.source_accuracy_policy: Official DEFRA/GOV.UK distribution and semantics are confidence 100 for source lineage; candidate numeric confidence remains 98 without raw row readback.
